behavior: A swift, powerful aerial hunter that scans from exposed perches, then pursues small birds with rapid, stiff wingbeats and catches them in midair. Usually solitary outside the breeding season and seldom soars.
field_marks: Compact, stocky falcon with a broad chest and blocky head
Adult males slaty gray above; females and immatures predominantly brown
Pale buff-to-cream underparts with heavy dark streaking
Short hooked blue-gray bill, deep-brown eyes, and yellow cere and legs
Broad-based wings tapering to sharp points
Dark, square-tipped tail crossed by narrow whitish bands
habitat: Open and semi-open country, including forest edges and clearings, grasslands, marshes, coasts, shrublands, and developed areas with suitable trees or exposed hunting perches.
